identity.lineage: Drawn on 7 Nov 2026 to the owner's brief: keep the 13:45 finishes and make every 13:35 a 13:45 too, every weekday closer from 15:45, 14 days' leave buying 30 days off, every rule and fatigue factor met, the fewest shift times, and competitive with the best in the league; and, asked the same day, no weekday early leaving as the 15:45 closers arrive. So no early finishes between 15:00 and 16:00: two finish at 16:00, 15 minutes into the closers' shift, and a fifth 06:20 opener at 14:50. Two 13:45s a weekday leave the weekday at most 7,400 minutes with nothing over 8h 30m, so the Saturday carries 7,100. No fatigue factor is present on the fixed duties, nor if a cover week falls badly.
